title: Canonical sections lift is invertible
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. The unique lift $l_q:\Gamma R_q\to(T.L).\mathrm{step}(q)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-sections-lift] is an isomorphism of complexes.

source.place: Proof remark (3) and finite-diagonal comparison; Tag 0133, augmented-total quasi-isomorphism

proof.text: The degree-n restricted mapped total is the finite sum over r ≥ 0, s ≥ q, r+s=n. The sections comparison identifies ΓR_q with that sum, and T.filtration_formula identifies the sum with the step. This gives an invertible component lift; uniqueness by cancellation of the monic step inclusion identifies it with l_q. Componentwise invertibility gives an isomorphism of complexes, including empty diagonals.
